summary: Drafted the Smart Reminders PRD: three email reminders around the due date, SMS out of scope, and a goal to cut median days-to-pay from 34 to 27.
ocr_text:
Smart Reminders PRD
Status: Draft v2   Owner: Jordan   Last edit was seconds ago
Problem
38% of invoices on Lumen Ledger are paid late; finance teams chase payments by hand
Goal
Cut median days-to-pay from 34 to 27 for accounts with reminders on
Scope v1
Email reminders 3 days before the due date, on the due date, and 7 days after
Out of scope: SMS reminders, custom cadences per customer
Success metric: 20% of active accounts enable reminders within 60 days
Open question: default on or opt-in for existing accounts?
outcome: PRD draft v2 sets the goal of cutting median days-to-pay from 34 to 27; default on versus opt-in is still open.
next_steps: Get eng and design comments on the PRD
Decide default on or opt-in for existing accounts
decisions: Keep SMS reminders out of v1
